answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks when every identity must earn a violet badge of verified work before it can vouch for others: a newcomer starts at dawn with no badge and no voting weight, and gains weight only by completing small jobs that independent peers check and sign. At the oasis of shared services, unbadged requests are throttled to a trickle, so a thousand fake accounts queue behind one honest worker. Buying identities buys no badge, and one forged receipt revokes it, so forgery costs more than honest work.
